newsitem.title: USA: Simon DeBartolo cuts credit pact interest.
newsitem.headline: Simon DeBartolo cuts credit pact interest.

text.p: Simon DeBartolo Group Inc said Tuesday it restructured its existing $750-million unsecured, revolving credit facility with an amendment that lowers the interest rate.

The company said the facility, which matures in September, 1999 and contains a one-year extension at the company's option, reduces the facility interest rate by 15 basis points to LIBOR plus 75. The amendment also increases the competitive bid option amount to $300 million from $150 million, the company said.
Simon DeBartolo Group is a real estate investment trust.
Its shares closed unchanged Tuesday at 29-3/4.
